pi.extensionsDeprecationNotice: pi-extension/alineo.ts's alineo_spawn/alineo_prompt/alineo_agents/alineo_kill typed tools have been removed in favor of bash-only CLI usage for all five alineo subcommands (alineo_fork was already bash-only) -- the typed-vs-not asymmetry between them was implicated in issue #21 Bug B (a model reached for the typed alineo_spawn tool instead of the alineo fork shell command the guidance text recommended for that scenario). Kept in place for backward compatibility -- no removal planned yet. The general Pi-extension-loading mechanism itself (this "pi.extensions" field, and a spec's own setup steps installing a custom .pi/extensions/*.ts file, e.g. @alineo-labs/agent-browser's) is NOT deprecated -- only this specific extension's typed-tool-registration responsibility is.
